1981-2415-4050-8319.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4050-8319.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Phyrexian Altar ability.
Repeat.

1003-5006-8170-8249.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Phyrexian Walker is starting in your graveyard.
1003-5006-8170-8249.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Phyrexian Walker spell. Then, activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

240-5231-5470-8201.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {R}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

618-5256-6132.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic with haste.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-5434-7357.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5434-7357.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Pugnacious Pugilist as attackers.
Pugnacious Pugilist triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
If the sacrificed creature was a Devil token, it triggers when it dies, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with "Sliver" chosen

1912-3767-4452-4465.description:
Activate Rukarumel by paying {1} due to Biomancer's Familiar and tapping it, creating a 1/1 Sliver creature token.
Activate the Sliver token using the ability granted to it by Basal Sliver by sacrificing it, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Rukarumel using the ability granted to it by Scuttling Sliver by paying {2}, untapping Rukarumel.
Repeat.

104-3490-3641-4659.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-3641-4659.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1329-2198-3200.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Urza's Bauble.
Cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

662-1129-1978.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Allies.
662-1129-1978.description:
Cause Harabaz Druid to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Harabaz Druid.
Repeat from step 2.

104-589-1786.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-589-1786.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fathom Mage.
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2457-4289-4365-4785.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2440-3263-3562-4183.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
2440-3263-3562-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sky Hussar with haste.
When the token Sky Hussar enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Sky Hussar trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Sky Hussar.
Repeat.

1812-2198-2440-4183.notablePrerequisites:
Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
{U}{R} available, plus an additional {U}{R} if you control less than three creatures that share a creature type with Deceiver Exarch
1812-2198-2440-4183.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {U}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Deceiver Exarch with haste.
When the token Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Deceiver Exarch trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Holding priority, if you control less than four creatures that share a creature type with Deceiver Exarch, repeat steps 1 through 3 one additional time.
Resolve all Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Deceiver Exarch for each trigger resolved this way.
Activate Prismite twice by paying {4}, adding {U}{R}.
Repeat.

955-1069-1232-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
955-1069-1232-5499.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1912-3719-3908-5326.notablePrerequisites: Spark Double has a power of at least 2.
1912-3719-3908-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Spark Double and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Spark Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Spark Double to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Spark Double by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

1987-4423-4863-5733.notablePrerequisites:
You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You control at least four Islands.
1987-4423-4863-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Notorious Throng by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Revolutionist.
When Revolutionist and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Notorious Throng from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Notorious Throng during your draw step.
Repeat.

1061-3942-5935.notablePrerequisites:
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
You have the city's blessing.
Cynical Loner does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent, or you have another way to tap Cynical Loner each turn.
1061-3942-5935.description:
Activate Timstream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Declare Cynical Loner as an attacker, or tap Cynical Loner by any other method.
At the beginning of your second main phase, Cynical Loner triggers, causing you to search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your graveyard.
Cast Timestream Navigator from your graveyard by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Kiora's Follower and without summoning sickness

116-283-5399.description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Pirated Copy.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Kiora's Follower's ability.
Resolve both Kiora's Follower abilities, untapping Pirated Copy and another permanent you control.
Activate Pirated Copy by tapping it, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.

618-2178-5231.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Thermopod with haste.
Activate the Thermopod token's second ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When the Thermopod token dies, Kiki-Jiki triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

1339-1385-1832-5231.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1385-1832-5231.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}
When the Insect dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

674-2206-2557-4231-5270.description:
Cast Gingerbrute by paying {1}.
When Gingerbrute enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate the two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Gingerbrute and the two Foods, returning Syr Ginger to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Syr Ginger by paying {2}.
When Syr Ginger enters the battlefield, Samwise triggers, creating two Clue, two Food and two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Activate Samwise by sacrificing Syr Ginger and the two Foods, returning Gingerbrute to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.

3995-4289-4944.notablePrerequisites: Horseshoe Crab does not have summoning sickness.
3995-4289-4944.description:
Activate Horseshoe Crab by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Horseshoe Crab by paying {U}.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Horseshoe Crab ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

2781-2902-4846.description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon by paying {3}{R}{R}{R}.
Worldgorger Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling all other permanents you control.
Journey to Nowhere leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Felidar Guardian from exile to the battlefield.
Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, blinking Worldgorger Dragon.
Worldgorger leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering its first and second abilities.
Resolve the second Worldgorger Dragon trigger, returning all permanents exiled with it to the battlefield.
Journey to Nowhere enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Felidar Guardian until Journey to Nowhere leaves the battlefield.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the first Worldgorger Dragon trigger, exiling all other permanents you control.
Repeat from step 3.

382-2034-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Basilica Shepherd.
When Basilica Shepherd enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-2493-2596-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {B}{B}.
2034-2493-2596-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {B}{B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Archaeomancer and Palinchron, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, then return all cards exiled this way to the battlefield.
Archaeomancer and Palinchron enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Archaeomancer trigger, returning Living Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Repeat.

396-2226-2232.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {7}{R}{G}{W}.
You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
396-2226-2232.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {7}{R}{G}{W}.
Cast Zacama by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
Zacama enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Cloudstone Curio and Blessed Sanctuary.
Resolve the Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Blessed Sanctuary trigger, creating a 2/2 Unicorn creature token.
The Unicorn enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Zacama from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1517-2402-4872.description:
Play The Mirari Conjecture and Time Warp, then go to the next turn.
Use Conjecture's 2nd activation to add Time Warp back to hand, then play Nesting Grounds.
Play Time Warp.
Go to the next turn.
Activate Nesting Grounds to remove a saga counter from Conjecture, then add back Time Warp when Conjecture's 2nd activation triggers again.

43-4415.notablePrerequisites: Non land mana sources that produce 3+ mana (one of which has to be white).
43-4415.description:
Cast Stonecloaker.
Paradox engine triggers untapping all our non-lands.
On resolution, Stonecloaker's ETB effects trigger, to preserve your own graveyard stack them as bounce, then exile, but to just exile all yards, order doesn't matter.
Tap all non-land mana sources for mana.
Responding to the exile trigger by casting Stonecloaker again allows you to repeat this process ad nauseum while only selecting a finite number of targets before letting the exile effects resolve.
